# Bid the board feet, the rim, and the coating.

> Price residential spray foam from the board feet an attic-square-foot special cannot see, the rim, the cell, and the ignition coating — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
